Text[0]: Given our rate of progress, I believe Auxesia is due for some special guests, don't you?
I will do whatever I can to assist Aunt Tii, be it at our manufactory or in regards to realizing her dream.
Player, welcome! Might I offer you a taco? Aunt Tii's authentic flavors have reached new heights of deliciousness, if I do say so myself.
Mrrrowow!
Mrrrow mrow? Mrrrow mrowow mrooow, mrow *mmmrrrooowww*!
In like manner to Oizys, we've deployed a fleet of repurposed warmachina to aid in exploration. It pleases me to see them put to good use!
When I joined this initiative, I was an outsider. Over time, however, the crew became more comfortable with me and my mechs.
Text[1]: Now I feel as though I belong here─well, in a manner of speaking. (I do miss Etheirys...)

Text[0]: If you love Aunt Tii's Tacos, you may also like...Triple Triad! Don't see the connection? Let's play anyway!
I...I won! My heart was beating so quickly... Let's go again sometime, all right?
Agh! You play better than most of our regulars... I'll be sure to practice, so don't think this is over!
Pffft... I almost got you! Ending in a tie is no fun, so play me again! Hurry up, now!

Thank you for helping Aunt Tii's Tacos thrive, Player! Oh, Mama has told me *all* about you. To be clear, you may be her favorite “niece,” but I'm her daughter─so I'll do my share in keeping her dreams alive!
I will continue to keep abreast of the situation in Garlemald via reports from the Ilsabard contingent.  Should another crisis arise, we will not hesitate to provide our support.

Vacationer Player! Resting hard or hardly resting? Ha!
I say, what is the Studium's obsession with touching our ears? Don't they realize it *tickles*!?
Text[1]: ...Ahem. Nevertheless, our cordial partnership shall continue for the foreseeable future. The scholars of Sharlayan are ever welcome to visit us!

Text[0]: You and yours have completed countless important missions for us. For the sake of our future research, I pray you keep up the good work.
Every contribution upon Auxesia is a show of goodwill towards the Nagylvi people. I hope you and the crew will stick around for a good long while.
Good day to you! My name is Inspectingway, and I am come from the moon in search of researchers willing to assist in interstellar advancement!
Text[1]: Alas, it seems everyone here has a great deal on their plates already. I wish I could help them...

Text[0]: I hear the Studium recently bore witness to the birth of a new academic discipline called “interstellar studies.” Indeed, my comrade Searchingway was well pleased!
Text[1]: Now that his Cosmic Exploration Initiative has established a base of operations on the moon, here I am, hoping to recruit Studium scholars for collaborative research!

Text[0]: Scholars of the Studium have now conducted field trips upon two different stars: Oizys and Auxesia. Not to boast, but it's a great achievement for the Cosmic Exploration Initiative.
Text[1]: In fact, through careful coordination with a Loporrit associate presently in the field, I myself helped to facilitate them! Both proved a roaring success!
Text[2]: Now I hear that the professors of the Studium are in talks to debut a new Faculty of Interstellar Studies... Oh, how wonderful to think I may have helped that along, too!

Text[0]: Oh, Player, how can I ever thank you? The Cosmic Exploration Initiative truly couldn't have come this far without the many contributions of artisans like you!
Text[1]: Having achieved our greatest ambitions, and tied up some loose ends on Etheirys, I daresay we've earned a spot of peace and quiet.
Text[2]: Our journey is far from over, and may one day take us to a new star─but until then, we'll study every ilm of Auxesia to ensure its story is preserved!

Text[0]: Thank you ever so much for accompanying me all the way to Gyr Abania. My last lingering regret has been resolved─*and* I learned I've got my own line of merchandise!
Text[1]: In all seriousness, I owe you much and more. Never would I have found my way back to the burrow had you not stopped on the street that day in Old Sharlayan.
Text[2]: Already I find myself pining for new locales in need of names...but for now, I shall concentrate my efforts here at Searchingway's side!

Text[0]: By popular demand, I've elected to reprise my role as overseer of operations. My whiskers are bristling in anticipation of progress reports!
Ye'd think me a plumber what with all the circuitry inspection they been askin' of me!
Gah hah hah! Ye should have seen Mumukko runnin' left an' right in that getup! Maybe now she knows how the rest of us feel, eh!?
Text[1]: Yet she sure don't show it, if so. Task after task after bloody task... Seems damn near nothin' gets 'er down!

Text[0]: At long last, I can finally take action... I'll tell you more whenever you have the time!
